methodology: Relevance labels were hand-authored by reading each candidate resume against each job description and marking a job as relevant if a competent human career counselor would tell the candidate to prioritize applying to it (strong skill/domain/seniority alignment) -- and, where an 'intended_role' is set, respecting that stated career intent over generic resume similarity. This is a small, manually curated set (7 candidates x 12 jobs) intended to demonstrate the evaluation methodology end-to-end, not to be a statistically robust benchmark -- see README 'Evaluation' for discussion of this limitation and how it would be scaled (e.g. real historical application outcomes, or the Kaggle 'Resume Data for Ranking' dataset via scripts/load_resume_ranking_dataset.py) in production. 'cand_pivot_analyst_01' is a deliberate intent-vs-similarity stress test: a data-analyst resume with a stated intent to move into GenAI engineering, used specifically to measure whether the Career Intent Layer correctly prioritizes the intent-aligned role over the resume's generic best textual match -- see /api/v1/evaluation/intent-impact.
